notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures, three of which are Elves excluding Thranduil that do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate three Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding {3}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking a creature you control.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
